title: Living Together
text:
Many people live in our city. They come from different countries and speak different languages. Some families cook food from their home country. Other people enjoy trying new foods.

This is called cultural diversity. In school, children learn about other cultures. They share stories, music, and games. Many people think diversity makes a community strong.

questions.text: What do children learn about in school?
How do the people in the city probably feel about different cultures?
options: They do not want to meet new people
They are probably interested in each other
They only eat food from one country
They never talk to their neighbours

questions.text: What can we infer about a community where people share stories and games?
options: It probably has good relationships among people

vocabulary.definition: the existence of many different kinds of people or things
a group of people who live in the same place or share something
systems of words that people use to speak and write
the ways of life, customs, and beliefs of a group of people

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas vivem na nossa cidade. Elas vêm de países diferentes e falam idiomas diferentes. Algumas famílias cozinham comida do seu país de origem. Outras pessoas gostam de experimentar comidas novas.

Isso se chama diversidade cultural. Na escola, as crianças aprendem sobre outras culturas. Elas compartilham histórias, música e jogos. Muitas pessoas acham que a diversidade torna uma comunidade forte.
